fact: On 12 September 2025 the DRC minister of Posts and Telecommunications met Tanzania's ambassador to finalise the 2022 Dar es Salaam memorandum for a Kigoma-Kalemie cross-border fibre line, with a joint monitoring commission said to be imminent.
title: RDC–Tanzanie : José Mpanda donne un coup d’accélérateur au projet de fibre optique sous le lac Tanganyika
